app.name: Network Config Manager
app.description: Network configuration backup, version history, diff, drift and compliance

scopes.name: storage:logs:read
scopes.comment: Read capture, version and index records

scopes.name: storage:metrics:read
scopes.comment: Read com.dynatrace.extension.network_device.sysuptime for the Coverage tab's address-to-entity join

scopes.name: storage:buckets:read
scopes.comment: REQUIRED alongside storage:logs:read - bucket-partitioned tables silently return 0 records without it

scopes.name: storage:logs:write
scopes.comment: Promote changed configs into the long-retention bucket

scopes.name: storage:bucket-definitions:read
scopes.comment: Initial Setup: check whether the ncm_index/ncm_captures/ncm_versions buckets already exist

scopes.name: storage:bucket-definitions:write
scopes.comment: Initial Setup: create the dedicated buckets (B4). NOTE: this scope grant alone is NOT enough - the app's OAuth client also needs the storage:bucket-definitions:write IAM POLICY bound to it by a tenant admin, separately from this consent

scopes.name: settings:objects:read
scopes.comment: Initial Setup: read the OpenPipeline pipeline/routing config to check current state before writing

scopes.name: settings:objects:write
scopes.comment: Initial Setup: create the storage-routing pipeline and append one entry to the tenant's shared routing config

scopes.name: extensions:definitions:read
scopes.comment: Initial Setup: list uploaded custom:ncm-collector versions and which one is active

scopes.name: extensions:definitions:write
scopes.comment: Initial Setup: activate an already-uploaded extension version. Does NOT allow uploading a new package

scopes.name: extensions:configurations:read
scopes.comment: Initial Setup: read the monitoring configuration's device list

scopes.name: extensions:configurations:write
scopes.comment: Initial Setup: add/edit/remove devices in the monitoring configuration (metadata only, never credentials)
